item.title: Gulls Look to Seal Weekend Sweep Over IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls look to keep their momentum going and take a sweep over the Rockford IceHogs tonight at BMO Center (2 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). The Gulls and IceHogs competed last night for just the seventh time in all of AHL history. San Diego took a 5-4 victory, making their all-time record over Rockford 6-0-1-0. item.title: Gulls Fall Short of IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls came up just short of the Rockford IceHogs today in game two of their back-to-back series at BMO Center, 2-1. item.description: The Anaheim Ducks announced today that the National Hockey League (NHL) club has recalled defenseman Ian Moore and center Tim Washe from the San Diego Gulls, Anaheim’s primary development affiliate in the American Hockey League (AHL). item.description: The San Diego Gulls announced today that the American Hockey League (AHL) club has recalled forward Coulson Pitre and defenseman Roman Kinal from Tulsa (ECHL).
